accounting_correction.change: reserve the maximum binary taker fee at any fill price at or below the FOK ceiling; because the fee curve peaks at 0.50, use min(price_ceiling, 0.50) as the fee-bound price

collateral_correction.change: require sufficient uncommitted cash before hedge submission and keep both legs' full fee-inclusive capital committed until market close because immediate merge is not assumed

state_feedback_disclosure.timing: before any candidate score and before the first eligible fresh window opened
state_feedback_disclosure.finding: a profitable complete-set lock can change realized-loss-dependent degraded execution and therefore change later entry membership even though the entry rule itself is unchanged
state_feedback_disclosure.evaluation_effect: score the full stateful candidate policy against the full stateful baseline, and retain sealed per-trade evidence so common entries, baseline-only entries, and candidate-only entries can be disclosed separately

candidate.params_hash_status: verified by Rust StrategyVariant deserialization and stable_json_hash

economic_contract.position_state: one directional binary-outcome position already filled
economic_contract.action: buy exactly the held share quantity of the opposite outcome
economic_contract.payout: one matched Yes plus No share pays exactly $1 at terminal settlement or can be merged into $1 collateral
economic_contract.selection_rule: submit only when the payout minus entry cost, entry fee, maximum hedge spend at the FOK ceiling, and maximum hedge fee at any fill price at or below that ceiling is at least $0.10
economic_contract.reason: only the missing leg is submitted, avoiding the unhedged first-leg risk of two independently processed orders

execution_contract.order_style: taker FOK with a fixed worst-visible-ask price ceiling
execution_contract.hedge_size: exact entry filled shares; partial visible depth rejects
execution_contract.book_walk: all visible opposite asks required in ascending native-book order
execution_contract.price_increment: Gamma minimum_tick_size captured with the market; invalid or missing values fall back to the engine venue tick
execution_contract.signal_cost_bound: all shares are priced at the submitted FOK ceiling, not signal-time VWAP; hedge fee is bounded at min(price ceiling, 0.50), where the binary fee curve reaches its maximum over all permitted fill prices
execution_contract.fee_rate_validation: non-finite, negative, or above 1.0 fails closed
execution_contract.failed_fok: retain the original position and wait at least one retry interval
execution_contract.fill_reconciliation_mismatch: retain the original position, keep the exit pending, trip the backtest breaker, and make promotion fail through unresolved-exposure and breaker gates
execution_contract.cash_availability: maximum hedge spend plus its maximum fee must fit uncommitted bankroll after open, submitted, and already locked complete-set capital
execution_contract.in_flight_reservation: the maximum hedge spend and fee remain reserved from signal submission through fill or failure so another order cannot reuse that cash during latency
execution_contract.collateral_release: both entry and hedge costs plus fees remain committed until the market close; no immediate merge or early capital reuse is modeled
